2608.09537.title: verdi: retrieval is not transfer for continual world model optimization
2608.09537.paper_summary: Foundation world models have made remarkable progress in planning, simulation, and embodied intelligence. However, optimizing a pretrained world model toward a user-specified objective remains difficult: each campaign typically rediscovers optimization strategies from scratch, and the resulting knowledge rarely transfers to the next model. Existing research agents automate the optimization loop but treat successful strategies as directly reusable recipes, without principled safeguards for when transfer is appropriate. We argue instead that retrieval is not transfer: a strategy validated on one model is at best an optimization hypothesis for another, and becomes transferable knowledge only after target-side experimental valida- tion. Guided by this principle, we propose VERDI , a continual framework for evidence-licensed world model optimization. VERDI characterizes each world model through shared inference-time probes to construct an Optimization Fin- gerprint, retrieves relevant prior experience as ranked hypotheses, and validates every candidate under a frozen target-side verifier before admitting it as reusable evidence; contradictions among nearby fingerprints further trigger probe evolution, continually refining the diagnostic representation itself. Experiments on Ctrl-World, the Cosmos family, and RoboCoin show that VERDI reduces search cost by 68%, GPU cost by 69%, and negative transfer from 0.34 to 0.06, while predicting transfer outcomes with 83% sign accuracy.
2608.09537.paper_summary_zh: 基礎世界模型在規劃、模擬和具身智能方面取得了顯著進展。<lb/>然而，將預訓練的世界模型優化為用戶指定的目標仍然困難：每個活動通常都是從頭開始重新發現優化策略，並且所產生的知識很少能轉移到下一個模型。<lb/>現有的研究代理自動化了優化循環，但將成功的策略視為直接可重用的食譜，卻沒有原則性的保障來判斷何時轉移是合適的。<lb/>我們主張檢索並不是轉移：在一個模型上驗證的策略至多是另一個模型的優化假設，只有在目標側的實驗驗證之後，才成為可轉移的知識。<lb/>在這一原則的指導下，我們提出了VERDI，一個持續的證據授權世界模型優化框架。<lb/>VERDI通過共享推理時間探針來表徵每個世界模型，以構建優化指紋，檢索相關的先前經驗作為排名假設，並在承認其為可重用證據之前，根據凍結的目標側驗證者驗證每個候選者；附近指紋之間的矛盾進一步觸發探針演變，持續精煉診斷表示本身。<lb/>在Ctrl-World、Cosmos家族和RoboCoin上的實驗顯示，VERDI將搜索成本降低了68%，GPU成本降低了69%，並將負轉移從0.34降低到0.06，同時以83%的符號準確率預測轉移結果。
